next_step: Run 2-week POC: index 120M embeddings, validate top-k reranker latency and SSO end-to-end
notes: Overview: Lighthouse CodeHub is an internal developer productivity platform used by ~4k engineers. Planning to consolidate multiple in-house search systems into a single RAG-enabled code search + knowledge base.

Primary ask: large-scale embeddings pipeline + accurate reranking. They expect ~120M dense vectors covering code blobs, doc pages, and commit diffs. Re-index cadence: incremental every 15m for commits + nightly full re-index.
Latency/throughput targets: developer interactive SLA ~P95 <300ms for dev-search queries; bulk analytics reranks can be slower. Target throughput: 200 qps sustained during peak (CI/job runners).
Cost sensitivity: high. Want per-query cost modeling for first-pass ANN + cross-encoder re-ranker. AE note: customer repeatedly asked "What does $0.XX/query look like at our scale?"

Architecture preferences: two-stage pipeline: ANN index (quantized vectors on dedicated nodes) -> top-50 cross-encoder reranker (smaller, distilled model). Prefers open weights or bring-your-own model variants to control cost.

Indexing constraints: monorepos with many small files; need chunking metadata (repo, path, commit, author). Delta indexing must preserve token offsets for precise code snippets. Handle Git LFS pointers and binary blobs exclusion.

Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML + SCIM, enterprise audit logs, KMS-backed key management, and EU data residency for some teams. Will run security questionnaire and expect ISO/SOC artifacts.
POC ask: show end-to-end pipeline on Dedicated or Private: ingest 10M sample embeddings, run reranker latency tests, surface cost projections, and run SSO test with IdP (Okta).

Recent call snippets: "We need reranking quality close to our current TF-IDF+heuristics but with much better semantic recall" — Eng manager. "If re-indexing stalls, developer trust collapses" — Head of Platform.
Notes on integrations: must plug into internal CI for auto-index triggers, and produce webhooks for commit-index completions. Prefers S3-compatible object storage for blob artifacts.

Risks: frequent re-index churn can bloat ANN index and increase latency; needs smart caching/partial index updates. They're concerned about memory footprint of 120M vectors and the economics of GPU-based rerankers.
Deal hygiene: legal introduced constraints around EU team data residency; procurement expects discounted committed capacity for Dedicated + longer lead time for Private on-prem deployment.
Next actions: 1) Technical scoping call 2026-03-03 with infra team to agree POC dataset and runbook (done). 2) Redwood to provide sizing doc + cost model. 3) Schedule Okta SSO test during POC week.
Short-term timeline: POC sign-off by mid-June; production pilot Q4 if POC meets latency + cost thresholds.
Internal AE tips: emphasize batching, prefix caching, and model quantization recommendations from Redwood Optimize to meet cost targets.
Quote for internal use: "If we can hit 200 qps and keep P95 <300ms with a <$0.02 effective query cost, they buy" — Head of Platform.
